record_title: Universal logarithmic dispersion fingerprint in degenerate mKdV-Burgers shocks
provenance: A source-specific asymptotic refinement of the monotone degenerate shock in arXiv:2609.20591v1. The right characteristic tail has an exact leading coefficient and a dispersion-dependent logarithmic second term, yielding a translation-invariant comparison law between dispersion strengths.
limitations: The result concerns the monotone degenerate shock profile and its right characteristic tail. It does not improve the nonlinear PDE stability theorem, treat oscillatory profiles outside the monotone regime, or classify higher-order tail terms. Jacobs-McKinney-Shearer (1995) remains a residual originality risk because its complete text was not inspected.
